text: This is some intense workouts! The remote control is your best friend, just remember that when you are out of breath!

I started the workout one week ago. I am pretty busy and needed a workout that I could do anywhere. With this workout there are no weights, a lot of cardio, and great results. With diet and the program I am already seeing results in one week. Shawn T is really encouraging and pushes you like a personal trainer. I also like the fact that the DVD's can be used anywhere, from home to hotel rooms. All you need is workout gear, shoes, a DVD player (or Computer) and a towel to wipe off the sweat (because you will be sweating). It is intimidating at first, but well worth it if you are willing to work.

Long story short, you can get a more effective cardio workout with more traditional burst interval training in a much shorter time.  You can get stronger and more toned, quicker, with weight training.  But you can't do both simultaneously.  If you have trouble motivating yourself, have a limited schedule, and care more about getting toned than strong, this workout is probably fantastic.  I, however, was disappointed.

So far I have loved Insanity....but would be nice if I could use all of the discs. 3 of the 13 don't work, very disappointing especially after paying so much for it. My advice-buy from BeachBody.com!!! not some random seller.

I wasn't consistently working out before, but after I got Insanity I can't stop!!! It's really hard at first and super intense, but once you get into the routine you WANT to keep going. I've been doing it for three weeks and I feel great and I'm starting to see my body change. If you don't follow the meal plan, at least eat healthy and stay away from junk food and sweets. That should do it. I'm pretty excited to see the results!!!

summary: Hardest workout that improved my running
text:
First, let me say that I have all the Jillian Michaels workouts, including her latest Ripped in 30, and I have Cathy Fredrich workouts including HITT, and run 3-4 miles a day, have P90X, have Chaleen Extreme, and Turbo Jam. I really like to workout at home. I have to say, in terms of cardiovascular endurance, muscular endurance and speed training, this is THE hardest workout I have ever done. I have been on Insanity for about 3 weeks now, and I am just now able to get through one of the workouts, which is only 38 minutes.

The best part of this is that I am able to see my stomach muscles after 3 kids that I have not seen in 10 years. In addition, my running, especially going uphill, is hardly a workout anymore. I use to run with my dog, who I could not keep up with (he's a young lab) to now me having to pull and encourage him to keep going faster and keep up with me. I can easily run 5-6 miles, at a 9 minute pace and feel like I hardly break a sweat.

I am 41 years old and feel like I am in the best shape of my life. Even though this is not a muscular building exercise, I have lost so much fat that I can clearly see ab muscles, shoulder and tricep muscles, back muscles, hamstring muscles. While this is hard and even the people in the video take breaks, for me, working out is not really working out unless it is effective in fat loss and strength and endurance building. It is worth the 40 minutes of panting!

I was skeptical about working out in front of the T.V.  After the first week of workouts I realize that I get a better workout from doing plyometric exercises than I ever got from the gym.  Insanity is intense!

summary: Buyer Beware when purchasing  DVD's from Franklin Supermart
text:
Franklin Supermart (seller profile)Shirley Co, in Alhambra,CANADA, make me so unhappy.

I ordered Shaun T, Insanity the Ulitmate Cardio Workout & Fitness DVD Program and some of the DVD's I couldn't play on my DVD player here in the United States because the disc said "Area Limitation".
So now I have to resend those DVD's at my cost back to them (Shirly Co in Alhambra CA) to do whatever they need to do.
When I emailed the seller (Franklin Supermart) and asked what the term "Area Limitation" meant, there was no explanation, instead I was told in the email to send the DVD's back to them. on my dime.

If you are ready for a workout that will kick your butt but doesn't take that much time, this is for you. I know I sound like an advertisement. I won't lie, it is very hard and super high intensity, but it also works and takes less than an hour. The first few days I hurt so bad I could barely walk, but I'm at the end of week one and I already feel better. I'll update, to show progress and that this workout really does its job.

Let me just start with the results--In 60 days I lost 28lbs and 27.25 inches from all over my body including almost 6 inches from my waist! And this was without sticking the the diet portion. Isn't that Insane!?!

If you think, "I'm fairly in shape, how hard could this be?" Pretty d*mn hard! My 16 year old athlete brother who started with me quit after a day, saying it was too hard. I was SO out of shape and this just proceeded to kick my butt. It was the hardest workout I've ever done! It's a combination of sports drill circuit training that will leave you SOAKED every day. I was sweating as much on day 60 as day 1. It never gets easier, you just get stronger!! No weights, just you pushing your body to it's limits 6 days a week. I NEVER skipped a day; as hard as it was, I made the commitment and never missed a workout, even if it required me working out at 2 a.m.!! It was the only fitness program I've ever stuck to. I can fit clothes I haven't been able fit since 2008! I've had this cute pair of designer jeans, tags still attached that I could never fit that I tried on and can finally button! I feel like so much more of a women now that I've gotten some semblance of a shape back!

I can't wait to get my Insanity T-shirt because I definitely earned it!! Shaun T and the crew is the great, BTW!! Come on y'all let's GOOOOOO!!!!

TIPS:
-Drinking 64oz + water a day is very necessary because you sweat SO much! If you don't drink a lot of water you will be dehydrated
-It's harder to do this workout on carpet, but also be careful with ceramic tile because your sweat makes the floor super slippery...Seriously, that's how much you sweat, you may slip on your own sweat!!!
-Ladies--a good sports bra is really important (maybe two!) because the jumping is so intense!
-You need something for recovery because you are pushed to your limits but I didn't buy the recovery formula from Beachbody, I used chocolate milk (Instant breakfast or Ovaltine); it's what athlete's use.
-Sometimes to switch it up, I used the No Music option and played my iPod instead, my favorite party songs helped me push harder
-Only do YOUR MAX, I promise I still barely make it through the warm-up yet even with all the breaks and resting, I still managed to lose a ton of weight

You can do it, dig deeper! Insanity works for you if you work for it. Round 2 here I come!

The workouts are hard.  Very hard.  But they are also seriously boring!! You repeat the same 5 exercises over and over and over (and I will spare you how many times you repeat the same thing), but at slightly different speeds.  It didn't keep my interest at all.  I got bored long before I got tired.  After 20 days, I shipped mine back.  It was not worth the money or the time to put the disc into the DVD player.  Waste of $25+ for shipping and handling.

Tired of purchasing LAME workout videos?  Me too.  Insanity was my last hope.  I typically bypass infomercials, but I was intrigued by Shaun T and his workout philosophy.  I've had the videos for about two weeks and I am 100% satisfied.  I would highly recommend the workout series to anyone/everyone, however use caution because it is insane.  Sounds cheesy, but you'll be saying it too.  I'm hooked!  Thanks Shaun T.!

summary: Two weeks into the Insanity Program
text:
We are now just beginning our third week and can say this program is everything it is cracked up to be. It is truly insane!! It is a complete package with DVDs covering each session along with the calendar showing what program to do on each day. A complete eating plan which is realistic and easy to follow is included.

Shaun T is an excellent motivator, he keeps you moving and digging deeper to complete the program. He demonstrates the exercises and shows the correct form for each. This program is not for those who make excuses. But if you like to push you body and work hard this is for you and will take you to a new fitness level.

Although we feel it will take us more than the 2 months to get the Shaun T body. We feel this is an excellent program and worth the money. It allows us to work out indoors as our weather is cold and rainy, although by the end of the workout the windows are open!

summary: If you're already in good shape review.
text:
Male 6'10- 250lbs

Lets me start of by my saying that I'm a lifelong athlete and I played basketball in Michigan about 7 years ago. I'm very active and in good shape. I wanted something that will challenge me again, so I got the set. I sure am challenged and it kicks my butt. This is a review for those people that are already in good shape. If you do it right, you will always be sore and wasted. Wife and I made this a together thing and we are currently on the recovery week. My wife wanted to drop about 5-10lbs and maybe get some toning, definition,better flexibility and overall better health, but so far no weight loss. This will for sure get you in top stamina shape; make your body harder and your quads much bigger. Most of the moves are quad dominate and there is no way around it. You will gain muscle and maybe burn some fat, so you might not see a huge drop on the scale. This is off course not a case for everyone and you might experience a much more significant weight/fat loss if you're 20lbs or more overweight .If that's the case, it would be impossible not to drop weight with this program. For those people that are already in shape it will be hard for you to drop the last 5 lbs because like I said, you will build muscle in your legs and you might lose muscle mass in your upper body. Also, if you are trying to burn fat from your stomach remember that this will be that last area where you will see a difference. Your body will burn fat from different places first and then refer to the mid section. Overall this is a very hard program and if you're already in some kind of shape you will get benefits of better stamina, better circulation, stronger core, flexibility, but not a sure fat loss.

I'm giving this 3 stars based on the difficultly of the program and the little fat lost. Pushing so hard and devoting so much time and energy should produce much quicker fat loss and not muscle mass in your legs. There are just too many moves that include jumping. Women don't want to have big thighs and this will sure make your legs bigger. I personally don't care, but you might. I hope after we finish the second month my wife will see that her hard work will show better results.

Insanity came new to me.. packaged in original wrapping. Everything was in good shape, except one of the DVDs skips... not sure if this is the manufacturer's issue or the seller's. Overall, I would buy from this seller again!

Sean T is an awesome, motivational, fitness instructor.  This workout will change your body if you stick to it.  I am training for a marathon and am on my second 60-day workout with Insanity and I would recommend it to anyone who really wants to change their body and get stronger.  The people in this series are really working out, and hard.  This is no workout for sissies.

I bought this DVD two months ago and can tell a huge difference in my body especially in my legs and stomach. This is more of a cardio workout but you should see some definition in your arms, legs and a smaller stomach. I think this will be a perfect workout before you start P90X. I had torn my ACL about 10 years ago and when I first started this exercise regiment,I used a knee strap on both my knees because of the reviews of this being hard on your knees and joints. Thus far, I havent had any injuries or pain in my knees from doing this workout but was very sore all over when I first started. I'm 39 mom of a two year old and was a light/moderate exerciser before I began. I've lost 10 pounds and most of the time, eat healthy. I don't get as tired chasing my 2 year old around like I use to and you do not have to keep up with the people in the video, just keep moving and take small breaks, you dont have to complete every set just do your best. The best thing about doing this is that people noticed I've lost weight and even though I dread doing it, I feel great after completing it. There is a lot of the same movements but still very challenging.

This came in perfect condition and shrink wrapped for shipping.  Every DVD I have run so far has worked perfectly and all the additional information - calendar, nutrition guide, etc - were all in the box when I received it.

I've been working out off & on over the last 10 years.
This years plan started with Power90, then INANITY (a new one for me) then P90X. Finished Power90, I was pumped up & looking forward to INSANITY.
I don't half-ass my programs & want the best results, so of course I'm eating the right foods in the right amounts, 5 to 6 meals a day plus taking supplements.
For me the results weren't worth all the "Insanely" hard works. I'll be starting P90X again. I get much better results from that.
I think INSANITY may be for people younger & fatter then me.

My son loves the intense workouts but about 20 days in, 2 dvd's didn't work and got no help from Supplier (Beachbody) or reseller (SERGFRO).  In short, exercise program is good, customer service to remedy situation was terrible.

This workout dvd is the best I have seen in the market so far. I have been using dvd as part of my workout for the past 25 years. I thought I was in good shape, untill I tried this workout. This workout takes me to another level that I never been. This is great and I'm enjoying it. Please if you are a beginner, someone who have not excercise in years, don't try this workout.

I was very satisfied with my purchase.I purchased this product June 1st and had originally said that i was going to receive my package in about 2 weeks and received in a couple of business days. Looking forward to doing business with you guys. Thanks so much.

The order came in decent time but 4 out of the 10 disks are completely damaged and not even usable. A few of the other disks also have damaged spots that skip when your trying to use them. I was beyond upset with the quality because of how much it was listed for.

The dvds come from China and are obviously knock offs (not "used" as advertised). But the seller is pretty good about providing a good product. Meaning, a couple of my dvds didn't work and he sent me new copies after I emailed him. Then again...a couple dvd's didn't work. And of the new ones he sent, one still didn't work. The workout was put together in a way where the clips were all out of order. So you can't follow the workout at all. So, overall I would say: good customer service, poor product.

I cannot rave enough about this workout.  Although, if asked when I first started, I would have said every bad word that came to mind.  In the beginning I often wondered if it was worth it...6 days per week of working out and I do mean work.  But when the end finally came I was glad that I stuck with it.  All I have to say is that this video is not for the weak willed, if you come up with reasons not to do it, you will not!!!  The first actual workout (not the fitness test) I felt...the next day and the day after that and the day after that.  I was sore for about a week, but I stuck with it and at the end of 4 weeks I was seeing results that I liked and I could've stopped there and been satisfied with my body but I wanted to see exactly where 60 days of insanity would take me.  And just when I thought I was getting used to the first half of the workout I started Insanity Max  and it kicked my butt all over again.  I loved not having any additional equipment, no weights, not resistence band, no medicine balls...just me!  I went from a size 14 to a size 8/10 (and I didn't even follow the nutrition plan, but I did control my portion sizes AND I still enjoyed my pizza and burgers, my desserts, and my wine! DISCLAIMER: RESULTS MAY NOT BE TYPICAL).  That was the fastest I've lost weight and the most toning I've done since I first started trying to lose weight after giving birth to my youngest who is now 4 and it took 60 days of commitment.  My advice:  get a supposrt system in place to motivate and encourage you and love to hate Shaun T (sorry Shaun T) that's what got me through it.  By the end of it all you'll feel stronger and be proud that stuck with it.  Good luck to all who undertake this endeavor, you will definately understand why this workout is called INSANITY!!!

well this goes to the people on the big side of the gene pool. I personally wight 256 pounds and im 16 years old. The first week was pretty hard but its about digging deep and the amount of determination you have. Over wight can do this program Im doing very well. I have lost 6 pounds the first week but remember the amount of wight you will lose in the begging of this program depends on how much you wight,because obese people tend to lose wight faster than thoes who are a on the skinney side.
I would recommend this program if your trying to lose wight. But remember its about determination, diet, and really giving it your all.

AND DONT FORGET TO STAY HYDRATED.

I am very pleased with my Insanity discs! The seller sent them to me early and even wrote Good Luck on the package slip. Everything came as promised and in excellent condition. This program is not for the faint of heart. Stay committed if you want results. One workout will have you pouring sweat from every part of your body.

This product is AMAZING. If you are in somewhat good shape and are willing to put in the effort for the duration you WILL see a difference. The first time you make it through an entire DVD without having to pause and catch your breath is a great feeling!

I bought these DVDs and these workouts are crazy.  I do like this program, just not when I'm doing it.  When I'm doing it, I think I must be insane to be doing this madness!  I'm 5 weeks in and am at or near the best cardio shape of my life (guy in his late 20s).  For me, it is crucial to stretch before the warmup of each DVD.  When I didn't stretch, I kept getting slight muscle strains, now I've started stretching before I start and everything is all good.

I have been shopping on Amazon for years and have bought countless products from them.. and never have i ever felt the need to write a review. Nothing has been either good enough or bad enough for me to have an opinion that I just NEED to share. I guess there's always a first.

I bought Insanity after watching the informercial even though I never really trusted them. Insanity seemed simple and true enough: no gimmicks, no fancy contraptions, just PURE HARD WORK and u'll get the body you've always wanted. I am getting married in a few months, so i figured hey why not give it a shot.

I've been fairly fit.. playing competitive sports from middle school all the way to varsity. I had a two year stint in the Army after college as well.. though i have to admit, the past two years, i've been going to the gym way to little and not eating healthy.. my fitness level though decent is no where near fit.

Onto the product: Insanity Works. plain and simple. The first week was quite shocking.. half way through the fit test and i realized how truly out of shape i was. wheezing, coughing and lying in a pool of my own sweat, i questioned if i had the will to continue. Just going through the warmup (Shaun T makes you do a circuit of about 7 exercises repeated 3 times without stopping) was a real challenge.

Somehow i survived and by the second week, i was feeling much better, being able to go through the whole dvd stopping only occasionally. By the second fit test, i was feeling good, my results showing a drastic improvement.

By the end of the first month, I was feeling fit and healthy, i dropped 6 kgs and 3.5 inches off my waist, and EVERYONE noticed how much leaner i've become.

Recovery Week: Don't let the title fool you.. recovery week is not easy! Although they are not the same intensity as the regular exercises, they will make you sweat!

So.. I just completed the first day of Phase Two and OH MY GOD. Shaun T kicks it at least 5 gears higher and pushes you to the max. It doesnt help that the first day of phase 2 includes a fit test AND a max interval training (team beachbody should consider changing this!), but I feel like I've started all over again. Phase Two workouts are ONE HOUR each and will absolutely destroy you.

So here I am writing this review with my arms barely working.. I am spent, exhausted, still pouring sweat but excited.. if the first day can make me feel like this, i can't wait to see the results at the end of the month.

Apologies for the rant.. believe me when i say this. Insanity IS THE BOMB.

Insanity definitely works and will get you in shape.  You should be prepared to make a commitment to do the DVD daily.  The workouts are hard and you will sweat a lot every time.  I found I had to make a few small adjustments to a few of the exercises because I simply could not do them (mostly the plank work) so I do " girl" style pushups instead of the regular, etc.... However, once I made these few substitutions, I was on my way to a better body.  I do recommend this workout and probably will add more beach body workouts to my collection in the future.  Shawn T. Is motivating and helps u do the exercises correctly.  This is no walk in the park.... It is real cardio and u will be sore.  Enjoy.

it's a really good workout, i've been doing it for a month now and I'm starting to see a difference in my body.
you have to be very carefull with the knees though or you might wanna quit in a couple of weeks.

Overall super product! The workouts are VERY intense but since they exercises change you do not get bored and the time goes quicker than running on a treadmill for the same amount of time. It is also motivating to do which is a huge plus! I would recommend doing this with a friend or family member as it makes it even more motivating!

Only thing I noticed is that for those people who want to loose weight while doing this, I found that it is helpful to run in addition to the workouts. The workouts are significantly improving my cardio capabilities however I do always feel skinnier after running and then doing this workout versus just the workout alone.

summary: Looking for a real Cardio workout - this is it
text: I am 40 years old and really needed something to work on my gut and give me more energy.  The workouts are "INSANE."  You sweat the entire time.  The video shows people who have been doing this for along time drop like flies from exhaustion.  In a weird way it motivates me.  This is a great buy but it does you no good if it just sits on your shelf.  Make the time and do it.

First off let me say this program is not for an out of shape individual.  I've worked out for 16 years, was in the Marine Corps, ran cross country in high school and have ran 50K's.  Let me tell you this is one of the hardest things I've ever done.  When the background people start leaving the set because they are exhausted you know this is crazy.  If you are out of shape do not buy this.  This is not for people looking to just get back in to exercising.  This is for a person that is in moderate to good shape.  You will definitely be ripped after 60 days by following the program and eating right.
I am LOVING this work out and I am SEEING results. Stick to the meal plan and stretch often and you will be loving it and seeing results too!

The title says it all. I heard all the hype about this video and wanted to try it out. I finally ordered it and insane is the right word for it. I consider myself in pretty good shape. I run three miles three times a week which apparently is not as good as I thought. I did the fitness test which is the first video and was completely out breath and tired. I had no trouble sleeping that night.

The second video I could not even finish in correct form I just did as much as I could and hoped for it to be over soon.

The nutrition plan is great too.

I would definitely recommend this video set to anyone serious about getting in shape.

Update: August 30 2011

I have completely finished the program. I have lost quite a bit of weight and my metabolism is very high. I started the program weighing 215 and I am down to 190. No more beer belly or love handles. The program is very intense but, stick with it and you will see great results.
Some of the DVDs in this set do not even work. What a ripoff! Very disappointed! These DVDs were obviously copies of the real thing.

I hate this workout, and I love it.  I did the P90X workouts, and to be honest, Insanity made them seem easy.  Not to say that P90X isn't great (it was), but this is focused more on cardio and plyometrics, which I hate and is my weak point.  All the more reason for me to get this workout!  I'm on my second cycle of the workout now, and I'll be honest, I could not get through a full workout for the first several weeks of my first try through this.  Definitely not for a beginner or those with a weak will!  If you don't mind sweating profusely in front of a family member or a friend, I'd definitely recommend finding a workout buddy because you'll need the extra motivation.  I got my sister to do it with me through the first two month cycle and it really helped me push longer.  To sum it up, I hate you Sean T!  And I love you :D

I actually loved Insanity. It pushed me, the music and workout was great. It was a great challenge and put me into perfect shape. However, a couple of weeks after completing insanity I started getting back pain which progressed over time. Ultimately it turned into a fully herniated disc. Now I am potentially facing a lifetime of pain and challenges.

I read many reviews before doing insanity about it being a high impact workout with repetitive jumping and motions that can cause deterioration in spinal discs. Oh how I regret not paying attention to that ahead of time. I'm 34 and was in good shape before I started insanity and have always been athletic. I've never had back pain before but now I'm stuck.

Also, I didn't actually experience any specific back pain or injury while doing the workout and I was careful to build up and use my core during any bending or back focused exercises. I believe it was just the intense, repetitive movement that deteriorated the casing on my disc and now I can't do any exercise.

Be careful with this.

summary: Insanity does work! Take it from me!
text: It works! I just started Round 2 of Insanity and let me tell you, I'm sooo glad I'm back doing 30 min instead of the hour! lol.. It is super hard but not impossible. Before Insanity I had never worked out in my life so I was really in bad shape but I stuck through it and I feel better than I ever did! So again it will work if you stick with it! It will kick your ass, make you puke and even make you feel soo sore that you can't even get out of bed! lol.. But the results are totally worth it!! =) Thank you and good luck! lol..

This collection is a one of the few TV infomercials for sports related activities that actually lives up to the name. It's very intense. You need a lot of space and you have to purchase some additional items (plyometrics mat, recovery formula), but definitely worth the investment. You'll sweat so much and really tone and define muscles you didn't know you had.

The production quality of the videos leaves something to be desired. It's basically an instructor and two other gymers working out on a basketball court. There is a super helpful countdown letting you know how much time you have left for each exercise and it comes with a tracking guide for progress, calendar, nutrition guide, and discs.

Due to the 'intensity' of the exercises, it's helpful to watch them all the way through and then do the routine because it's sometimes hard to keep looking up at the TV. Happy working out!

Best workout ever. Like all Beachbody workouts this is exactly what it says it is and results are a given if you follow the plan. The formula is simple. Go like hell, rest and go like hell again. You rest when you need to and you go at your own pace. However, you will want to push yourself to the absolute limit.

I absolutely love this DVD. I have myself and three of my four kids doing it. We look forward to it.  Although it is really toughwe love the challenge. And we are all seeing results.  I have lost 10 pounds in 3 weeks and feel great. And I'm 52 years old.  I highly recommend this program.  It also as brought our family closer together for a healthy cause.  Thank you Shaun T.  We also just started hip hop abs too.  Love love it.

I once heard that this was the hardest workout on dvd and I agree. Don't let that intimidate you; this workout is designed to push you to your max so no matter how good or bad of shape you are in you can benefit from the interval training because you go as hard as you can personally go. My fiance and I are still in the first month of training and though the workouts are repetitive, they go by fast due to the intensity of them.

The true gem of the workout is the diet and nutrition plan. It is simple yet offers variety and customization. Many of the meals are delicious, some not so much, but you have to remember that nutrition is 90 percent of the weight loss or gaining battle.

One area o caution for those packing a few extra pounds. Make sure you are sticking to the 40% protein, 40% carb and 20% fat breakdown. It is easy to stick to the calorie allotment but it is also very easy to eat a lot of carbs and sometimes difficult to get the right amount of protein, especially if you are eating 400 or 500 calorie meals.

As far as muscle building is concerned, this workout is not about that. It will eventually help you get ripped and your legs take a beating, but this workout uses no special equipment so some areas, back and biceps particularly won't get worked enough to give you a fully developed physique. You can do one-three weight training sessions per week to make this a complete program.

I am 20 and just started the 2nd month of Insanity. Before starting the program I considered myself to be in pretty good shape, but was unable to even complete the Fit Test because I was so tired. The first month pushes you very hard and you will see some results. However, after doing the first two workouts of the second month, I feel like I didn't even do the first month, it's that intense! As long as you stick to the schedule and push yourself through each exercise, I guarantee you will see results.

I don't use the meal plan, but I find that the workouts themselves curb my appetite. You will sweat so much that you need to shower afterwards, but I've found myself sweating after a 5 minute shower on the coldest setting. I do this workout barefoot because I have white carpet in front of my tv and don't want to scuff it up with shoes. I have yet to have any problems from doing it barefoot. My only complaint about the program is that there aren't any stretches targeted for calves only and they get worked a lot. Sometimes my calves feel too tight during some of the exercises and occasionally feel restless in the morning.

Awesome, this will take you out of your boredom workout, I did not follow the 60 days plan, but I can tell I'm toning my muscle & seeing some result in scale. I will continue until I lose that stubborn 10 lbs.
Difficult, but so worth it. Shaun T. is very motivating and I feel great when I'm done. Saw results within the first couple of weeks

I'm just about finished with the 2nd and final month of Insanity. All I can say is Shaun T is the best. I've been a big proponent of going to the gym and working out with weights and cardio machines. The ONLY reason I decided to go the "workout-at-home" route is because I had to work for several months in the Virgin Islands and I didn't want to use the lackluster gym at the hotel. Going into this, I thought that I was in great shape because I workout regularly and I eat well. Fortunately, Shaun T put me to shame! The Max Interval training method that Insanity uses is just crazy. No matter how good in shape you are, you're pushing your body to the max so you're always getting better and stronger. What little body fat I had is practically gone. I look and feel stronger. I am definitely more flexible since Shaun T emphasizes a lot of stretching. And my mid -30s heart just "feels 'Ford Tough'".

So how does Insanity burn the fat and get you in the best shape of your life? You are constantly sweating. From the 5 minute warmup to after the DVD stops, you are sweating constantly. I have never worked out so hard in my life. This DVD set is everything that it advertises itself to be. The only thing it doesn't tell you is how hard it is to stick to the program because you're working out 6 days per week even though you may sometimes feel like throwing in the towel every day (note: 1 day is devoted to cooling down and stretching, but you end up sweating a whole lot on that day as well). Shaun T is a great motivator. But this workout is really insane. Even the people on the DVD who are all in excellent shape are stopping to catch their breath and shaking off muscle fatigue because Shaun T just doesn't stop.

All in all, if you're up to what I believe is the ultimate workout challenge, pick up Insanity. You will definitely notice and feel a physical transformation from start to finish. Shaun T, you are the man!
This workout will definitely make your knees feel like jello but it works.  Stick to the schedule and diet plan.  This workout is intense though. Love it!

I will keep this short and sweet.  Yes the workouts are hard, probably harder than anything you've ever done unless you've been in basic training.  Yes you will want to quit after the first DVD, but KEEP going!  I am 5'9" and weighed 264.4 lbs when I started.  After completing the 60 day workout I lost 18 lbs.  Also my doctor is now considering taking me off my high blood pressure medication.  Before I starting I could not run a mile without stopping.  Now I can run almost 3 miles nonstop.  This program will get you in INCREDIBLE shape.  I highly recommend this to anybody!

These videos really do work you out and make you break a sweat. I have always enjoyed these videos enough though they are tough. You really have to be serious about it and dedicated to see the results. Also, the product arrived on time and was in great condition-just as the seller noted. I got to start my workout as i planned on my calender. It was brand new and appeared to have never even been open. I am very happy with the product.

The program itself is great, but the biggest problem is that two disks don't work.  My take on this experience is to NEVER order this on Amazon because you cannot get disk replacements.  Beachbody will only do this if you ordered directly from the manufacturer.

I decided to try the Insanity workout DVDs because of the great reviews. Started the Insanity workout in March. I haven't seen much change in the shape of my body, but my conditioning is better. Since I'm in better condition, I go to the gym and get a total full body workout.

The warm-up is way too fast to be called a warm-up and the stretches start 10 minutes into the video.

The workouts are overly complicated routine moves which really drags down the quality of the video. I spent more time checking form than actually doing the moves, and he rarely give good advise on the form. Secondly, if the move is so complicated that form is that critical, maybe the move should be re-evaluated. I think the makers of the video tried to be novel, when they should have tried to make a decent video.

Lastly, the moves in this video could really shock the knees and the legs because of all of the jerky movements. I would recommend doing a good yoga video to gain flexability. Flexibility is something that won't be acheived with this video.

I would recommend this video for conditioning, but don't believe the hype. You can go to the gym and obtain the same workout, with a well structured routine.

I bought the Insanity work out program because I wanted to lose about 30 lbs. I have been doing insanity for about 30 days. I will be the the first to tell you- this is NOT an easy work out. I drip sweat every single time I work out. However, it is worth it. Not only do I look better, I feel better as well.

As far as results go, I've lost 5 lbs so far but it looks like I've lost much more. I've toned and gained a lot of muscle. I recommend taking pictures each week because the scale can be misleading. I haven't followed the meal plans that were included but I have been keeping track of my food intake.

The pause button is your friend, especially in the beginning. I went at my own pace but still pushed myself. Have plenty of water on hand too. Stay motivated and on schedule and it will transform your body.

summary: review on the exercises then on the seller
text:
The exercises are great. I am almost done for week 6. I do not follow the diet guide, but I have to say that I see results and I LOVE IT.

Now for the seller. I purchased the product thinking it was a used product NOT a bootleg product. The package at first seem funny, but my husbandy told me not to worry about it. Now I am the INSANE ABS portion and the seller recorded the DVD incorrectly. The first ab workout doesn't even start correctly when it skips to the next ab work out. The DVD has no scratches so I put the DVD back into the DVD Player and watched the whole DVD. All the exercises are recorded about 3 to 4 seconds long. I am very disappointed.

I have always hated cardio workouts. I HATE running and just get bored doing cardio. The only way I've been able to do cardio is in a class or watching DVD's like this. Shaun T was an excellent instructor, to an extent. He was very motivating, fun and I really never got tired of him. He encouraged you to take breaks for water and reminded you to keep your core tight often, sometimes I forget, so that was very good! However, he didn't explain WHY you're doing certain things. He mentioned in one of the Max DVD's (which you don't start until after the first month) that you should be able to see the tongue of your shoe when you're doing a ham string stretch in order to tell that your leg is straight. It really made a difference in my stretching, but I really wish he would have mentioned that in the first DVD! Also, he always says "Check Your Heart Rate." You can easily find that info online, but it would have been nice for him to say a little something about why you want to check it and at what range one should be at.

With those few negatives aside, this was an INTENSE workout. After the 10 minute warm up I would be drenched!!! It never got easier, if you're pushing yourself to the max every time, it won't get easier, you will just be able to do more in the same amount of time. I, unfortunately, didn't get the amazing results I was hoping for. I know I got a good workout though and even though I completed the program, I still go back and do the workouts.

Another thing, I kept having problem with my feet hurting just 10 minutes into the workout, so I tried it without shoes, and it was so much better! I had a mat and some padding underneath and it worked great. I would put my shoes on for some of the pushup exercises, however.

All in all, this is an amazing workout program. People have had amazing success and results with this program, but I did not, so I can't give it 5 stars, but I can still say it's a great program.

I'm about halfway into this system so far, right in the middle of my recovery week, and I gotta say that its just...well...just great. There are several things a person should know before doing this though. For one, its NOT for beginners. To clarify, if you can't run a couple miles, can't do 50 or so pushups and situps, then you're not ready for this thing yet. I did basic weight training, with one day of cardio a week(not trying to look good, just tryin' to feel good y'know) so...y'know...I thought I was in fairly decent shape. But the first week had me barely able to crawl out of bed.

If you're thinking of getting this, let me draw out exactly what is involved.

Workouts consist of a 7 or so minute solid cardio warmup, followed by a few minutes of stretching, then the actual workout routine, then cool down stretches. The whole thing will typically run about 45minutes or so if you don't take additional breaks. They sometimes run longer, sometimes shorter, but all in all, anticipate needing a full uninterrupted hour every day. You will also need a bit of space to do these workouts, I personally have had success with an area of about 6.5 x 6.5 feet. Ideally, I'd like to have more room, because I have to shorten a few of the workouts to fit my area, but it works well enough. You will also need a house, ground level apartment, or understanding downstairs neighbors. If you don't make a degree of noise with your foot steps, you aren't doing them right.

You should also invest in knee braces if you have weak or injured knees. These workouts involve a lot of jumping and other such moves that produce a strong downward force on the knees. For this same reason, you need to listen to Sean when he says to focus on your form, because if you don't do some of these workouts right, you WILL injure something.

Most of these workouts are such that you can add equipment to increase the effectiveness of the workouts. I added a weighted waist slimmer and overweighted it to 7 lbs. Strapped that on my third week and haven't stopped using it since. Though the workouts will be effective all on their own for quite some time, trust me...

I'm almost moving off-topic, but you need to drink a LOT of water when doing these workouts too. I personally go through about a liter of water each workout....and I don't have to pee afterwards.

Also, for you pirates out there...you're gonna miss out on something that helps a LOT. The results and recovery formula. It really helps the recovery process...if you torrent this then you're gonna have to cobble up your own effective recovery remedy because you won't go far in this system without it.

Thats it for now, I'll update this when I get through with the entire routine.

This is a great program, but make sure to judge correctly if you're ready for it before investing so much money in a workout program. I'm a bit overweight and can do moderate to high level intensity workouts. This workout humbled me. I couldn't finish the workouts because I couldn't breathe.
Now, I still think this is a great program. My brother and his roommates have all completed it and absolutely love the program! They were all pretty fit and only had a few pounds to lose, but they all look the best I've ever seen them.
I would just advise that you are truthful with yourself about whether you think you can do it. If you are hesitant, I'd say you're probably not ready and need to work up to Insanity (which is what I'm doing, just started Turbo Fire). If you "know" you can do Insanity, you are probably in the right mindset for this program, it takes a lot of dedication and stamina.

You will definitely break a sweat doing these workouts. You work all of you muscle groups without having to use machines or weights. You never get bored because you are doing different exercises throughout the workout and there is a big emphasis on stretching to avoid injury which I love. I would recommend this workout to anyone that is serious about getting into shape. However, if you are not in good shape already you may have to modify some of the exercises until you get stronger.

This program is absolutely amazing! Before beginning, I considered myself pretty fit, working out 5-6 days a week doing several cross training exercises (swimming, biking, running). This program completely kicked my butt! Shaun T. was very encouraging and he made the workouts fun. It was also great to see others in the video who had already completed the program stopping to take breaks. I do think there are a couple important notes to make though:
1) Others have said it, but seriously, if you have any kind of joint problems, do NOT use this program! Not being prone to injury, I still often noticed that my knees were sore after a lot of the jumping exercises.
2) Sure, doing these workouts will help you get in better shape, but if you really want to see results, you must follow the nutrition plan closely. I used to be in the school of "eat whatever you want in moderation," but still ate fairly healthy (with a healthy amount of splurging). I had stubborn spare tire fat that just would not go away. I started doing research into this nutrition plan, and it is definitely solid. And the best part is that you have choices for each of your meals, so you're not stuck eating the same thing every day, and you aren't forced to spend $50 a day on groceries. I usually picked out the foods I wanted to eat that week, and I'd stick to a particular food for my breakfast or mid-morning snack each day for the week (e.g. cottage cheese with fruit) to ensure I could buy one tub and have it last me the whole week, and also make sure I ate it before it went bad. These foods also helped give me the energy I needed to do these workouts, especially in the second month.

Overall, this program is freaking INSANE. If you want something to kick your butt into shape, I highly recommend it. I plan on continuing to use these workouts regularly to help me maintain. Hope this helps!

Okay I'm not going to give you a book here about my experience with this workout, just know that the results are real as long as you stick to the schedule. I'm just going to tell you what you need to do to survive the 60 days and how to reduce your fatigue and soreness.

1. Drink as much water as possible before, during, and after (helps remove lactic acid which causes soreness)
2. Eat plenty of HEALTHY foods to fuel your workout, not junk foods! (I am hungry and thirsty all the time due to the demand on my body)
3. Wear supportive shoes and purchase a thick workout mat to give support to your joints and back (this workout contains many exercises that punish those areas of your body)
4. Stretch, Stretch, Stretch! This will help with soreness. Stretch before, during, and especially after for best results. This also prevents injury. I stretch more and longer than they do on the videos. Also I do different stretches that work better for my body in particular.
5. Understand your body and what it is telling you. Your body can be pushed well beyond what you think is possible. By pushing yourself, without injury, you will see results. Don't try to keep up with the people on the dvd! Eat, hydrate, stretch, and you'll be in better shape in 60 days. If you're honest with yourself about giving 110% each workout then the results will be real for you too.

Insanity is incredible.  I'm 42 and  have never been a fitness type of guy, but wanted to do something at home. I purchased "Insanity" and have just completed week 4 of 9. This is the best I have felt in years! At first I watched the DVDs and thought, "OK, I have bitten off too much." I would take so many breaks, pause the DVD, but finished each program. However, I stayed with it and am now keeping up with those in the DVD and never hit pause! It has changed my life. I may have only lost 5 lbs., but my muscles have been redefined; I couldn't be more pleased with the results.

I was disappointed in the Plyomentric DVD that didnt work (bought used from BOOKS FOR EVERYBODY), disk was unreadable in multiple DVD players. The back of the DVD doesnt look scratched so I suspect it was burnt.  So far the other DVD's worked but I havent made it through all of them yet.  Everything was included in the set but still a let down.

This is my second week working out to this program and have seen results! I must say that if one is serious about this work out, follow the meal plan! I gained more energy and currently dropping the weight! There is a day of rest at the end of the week and a recovery day in the middle of the week. The DVDs are well organized in a small case and the calendar is extremely important...It helps one figure out what DVD to use and when to rest!

summary: Shaun T. Insanity 60 Day Workout Program
text: This workout is truly insane, but if you love to exercise, truly desire a healthier you and sleeker physique, it IS the workout for you. I love it!  I work about about 4 to 5 times a week, the workouts are hard, but fun.  Shaun T. is awesome!  He talks you through each exercise providing both encouragement and the option to take a break when you need it - and believe me, if you are not already in great shape when you start this program you will need to take a break or modify the exercise - which is not a problem at all.  Shaun T. gives you suggestions and shows how to do each exercise at different levels.  I was cautious before I bought this program, wondering if I was getting in over my head and wondering if I should start with the PX90...I am so happy that I bought Insanity!  It is worth every bit that I paid for it!

I have purchased the Insanity and p90x workout. I am not affiliated with beach body nor do I sell any of these products.

The fact about these programs are..........YES you will lose weight, gain muscle, and become more fit. I 100 % guarantee it. But you have to follow the guidelines.

First off, you have to change your bad eating habits and implement a lifestyle change. These programs will not work if you don't. Fact, you will not get the results you see in the pictures of people who have gone through the program ,if you ignore your diet.

Second. Intensity is the key to these or any type of work out. If you are not drained at the end of the workout you will not see max benefits.

Diet, Intensity and commitment are what you will need. If you don't like these programs that's fine but you will still have to apply the same guidelines to any program you chose, if you want results.

Insanity and P90X are the real deal. If you are really out of shape, choose something else, you are not ready for this. Start with some of the less intense programs Beach Body offers then come back to Insanity or P90X

I have been an athlete most of my life and I let my fitness level and waist line slip. Working with these programs re-motivated me and got me back into shape. I lost 30 pounds and I am in great shape. I did not lose all the weight in the time frame indicated in the program. WHY? Because it took me some time to change my diet. Once I did, the weight came off quicker. I lost 30 pounds in about 5 months. But that's the beauty of these programs you can customize them to fit you.

I'm 54 years old and I feel great. I've almost got that six pack that a bad diet kept out of reach.

If you have questions, I will regularly check the comments and answer your questions.

The good:
It's all body weight exercises, which means you can do it in your own living room with no equipment. This is wonderfully convenient.

My cautions:

First: I want to echo what some other reviewers have said: this workout is HARD on your knees.

Second: This workout is repetitive. Shawn T. tries to mix it up into about 10 different CDs, but at the end of the day, you're doing a lot of squats, burpee variations, push ups and jumping.

Third: It's asymmetrical. It's pretty common knowledge that it's best to train complimentary muscles together. So, if you do a pushing movement, you should balance it out with a pulling movement. This program does not really abide by this principle.

Fourth: It's REALLY grueling. Maybe I just wasn't in good enough shape to do it, but I've done lots of intense workout programs over the years (Cross fit, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, MMA). I've never felt as worn out and fried as while doing Insanity. And I'm not just talking about during the workouts; I'm talking about all the time.

Overall, I think there are smarter workout programs out there that offer more return for the amount of effort they require.

I was really scared to order it because I heard it was so intense and thought that I wouldn't be fit enough to even start it. I ordered it anyway and I am in love. Even in the first few days, the workouts are really tough but Shawn emphasizes that everyone needs to take breaks. The people in his video take breaks!

I also thought it would be impossible for me to get through that many cardio reps but he does between 2-3 minutes of 4 different cardio intervals and then there is a break. It is totally manageable but still pushes you really hard. It's nice to know there is always a rest around the corner, and there is a clock to let you know exactly how long until the next break.

I love that it is set in a gym, you can see the cameras moving around to get different angles, and they have a bunch of people doing it. It doesn't seem like a huge production where they try and make everyone in the video look perfect, they are really just doing the workout with you.

Lastly, I really like that the program tells you what workout to do when. All you have to do is set aside the 40 minutes and the rest is thought out for you. Awesome.

summary: Best way to take fitness to the next level
text: I received this is a Christmas gift and began the program this summer as a P90x/Insanity hybrid. It has been the best way to challenge my fitness level and keep me motivated. I'm really looking forward to completing the 60-day training. I can already feel a difference and am pumped to continue.
I've decided and am committed....can't wait for the SUCCESS!!

summary: Doesn't burn what you think it's burning...
text: I had to write this to inform people. Insanity is a great workout for sure. You will sweat BIG time but that sweating is deceiving. I started counting calories and fitness so that I would know exactly what I was burning off in a day after about a month of doing insanity with not very many physical results to brag about. When I calculated the math on Insanity turns out I was only burning about 300 calories per workout. I did further research, maybe it's just me....Nope, most everyone I found on the internet that calculated were burning 300-400 calories on every single session, even the longest ones. Was I working hard enough? Let's put it this way I was monitoring my heart rate and had to stop because I was in my danger heart rate zone. The most calories I found someone burned was a longer session and their top number was 454. Then I thought well this is interval training so you burn calories all day long after Insanity workouts. Ohh, oh...you burn about an addition 50-70 calories a day due to interval training. I'd rather have that slice of cheese and run and burn double the amount of calories you do by sweating your balls off with Insanity. It's a good sweat but 300-400 just isn't enough for me but to each his own!

I'm really enjoying this workout but I will caution anyone who has any issues with ankle, knee, leg, or back issues at all, which will only get worse with this workout.  I am very healthy and pretty fit already, and did not have any issues prior to starting this workout.  I can see that if you do have body pains, this workout will most likely make it worse. The Insanity disclaimer is pretty clear about this but I know many will not read it and purchase anyway.  They do not give modifications, but I modify several of the moves on my own and am seeing very good results so far.  This is an extremely fun and quick workout.  The first half (month 1) is under 41 minutes and second half (month 2) gets up to 60.

I finished the 60 day program and can tell you without a doubt this is a terrific workout program.  There are so many positives about this program.  Only 40-50 minutes a day for an intense workout the really targets your abs.  I have been trying to get rid of my beer belly/love handles for years and I can tell you the cardio I was doing didnt really have material results.  I now have six pack abs and have lost around 15 lbs.  Although I reduced my alcohol intake, I did not follow the recommended diet.  However as I begin to lose my stomach I became more motivated to eat a bit less.  I loaded the Insanity program on my Ipad so its very convenient to travel with especially since you do not need any equipment.  I can even do the program in a decent size hotel room and it definitely counteracts the large business meals you have on the road.  I am now repeating the program just to keep my abs and perhaps lose a little more weight.  I think the only negative is that the workout can be on your joints, especially your knees. summary: Sweat, sweat, and more sweat.  YES!
text:
I've done P90X twice, and it worked wonders. Insanity is another great BeachBody product. I've completed the first two weeks of the program, and am already seeing results - I lost nearly 4 pounds my first week week on Insanity.

Insanity is different than P90X - P90X breaks you down and builds you up by training you to near-failure with body weight and dumbells, and Insanity pushes your cardiovascular system to the limit by moving faster and harder than P90X does (no weights used in Insanity). If you think Insanity will be a breeze because you can make it through a P90X workout without much trouble, THINK AGAIN! This is the real deal. It's tough, and you're gonna love it.

If your goal is fat loss, I'd go with Insanity. Fat doesn't stand a chance against these workouts, but it's hard to gain muscle at such a high burn rate. If you want to put on a bit of muscle, but still get chiseled and defined, go with P90X.

I am half way through the 4th week, and I can tell you this program works. I am down 6 pounds, and I didn't have a lot to lose.

I originally bought this to stay fit between marathon training sessions, but now realize that I'm getting much fitter.

I don't run while doing it (don't have the time or energy), and am very curious to see how my times improve from this workout alone.

In short, this thing will kick your butt, I don't care how fit you think you are. It is definitely NOT for beginners. And I don't think it's that hard on the joints; you just need to learn to land with soft, bent knees (absorb the impact).

One note, I would seriously consider buying this directly from beachbody. There are a TON of illegal copies out there that skip or don't play at all. Bite the bullet and pay full price; you don't want to pay half price for crap...
The product got here when it was supposed to, and everything was in perfect condition.  I couldn't have asked for anything more.

First time reviewer here... I will start by saying I had a feeling these dvds would work by the little bit they show on infomercials. I know enough to realize that working out 6 days a week - and cardio to boot will burn some calories... The problem of course it getting yourself to do it... The Insanity 60 day program with Shaun T. at the helm is the ticket. Perfect combination of workouts - which are HARD!! Easy to follow calander... turn off your brain and just put in the DVD of the day... and get pumped and focused because its a tough 40 minutes... every time... but as Shaun T. says... 'i love it!'

Specific details and comments...
Me: 42 years old... Female... 5'2" fairly active for my age in my opinion... fell out of the 'workout routine' and put on about 10 lbs... target weight is 115... I started program at about 125... maybe a bit more but who whats to claim that!

Where I am in program: I just finished the first month and am in my 'recovery week'.

My experience so far...

First three days of workouts... with the intense use of calf muscles... I could hardly walk...Calf muscles VERY tight... but not surprising... if this happens to you just fight through it...As with sore muscles... after walking/hobbling around for a few minutes things loosened up... I had my 'breakthrough' on the morning of the 4th day.. ie... minimal soreness in calves!

First 2 weeks.... Tough... could not keep up throughout the complete routine... some sets tougher than others... but by taking minimal breaks.. never more than 30 seconds... I was able to muddle through... you do a couple of dvds in rotation... as the second week went by I already found I was keeping up better and form was more solid especially later in the sessions.. I was getting stronger! yea!

Second two weeks... same dvds for the most part with added core sessions of about 15 minutes on a few days... still building on base for strength... Doing a lot better and noticing much better flexibility and stamina for the workouts... Really enjoying it!

Got through first month without missing a workout! Very proud of myself... I am now on my third day of 'recovery week'...

Dont let that title fool you... you will work your butt off in the recovery week but it is definate a notch or two down on the intensity scale. Slower pace but lots of really painful squat stuff...

Really looking forward to what month two has in store... I have a feeling it will be extremely tough but the way the program is designed I believe I will get through...

Random thoughts/comments:

body changes... already noticable... I did not take official weights or measurements as it is not about that for me... cloths were getting Tight! simple as that... In the 4 1/2 weeks my jeans are fitting much better and I can start to see my abs again... Very pleased thus far.

Diet... the nutrition book that comes with Insanity is awesome... VERY easy meal selections... NOTHING crazy.. normal everyday food... easy to follow... no excuses people...nutrition is important... I firmly believe... as told... excersise and diet are the key to success... do youreself a favor and commit fully!

DVD variety... Very good... even though you repeat programs, they are always 'new'... as you get stronger you can push a bit more so it seems to be an ever evolving situation...

Shaun T... Very good... easy to listen to.. not overbearing... very encouraging... somehow makes you push from the TV... I like him... very well thought out programs... just when you think your legs will crumble or your heart will explode the next excercise focuses on something else and the body part that is maxed out has a bit of time to recover...

Best aspect for me... personal reason for being so happy with this system... I assume month two is same in this respect... You need nothing other than yourself and a medium to play dvd and about a 4 x 10 area to work out in... With travelling for work I believe this system is perfect... I can bring the dvds I need for my travel days and get it going on the road. This for me is huge!

Will post update when I finish the second month...

Have fun people... Insanity is all it claims to be... but you gotta commit and prepare to suffer a little bit...

Great workout, very intense like everyone says. This is, like the product says, a total body conditioning program. You will jump, dive, dip, push-up, and stretch. It's not just about getting thinner; if you want to do that, just get on a treadmill/elliptical for 20 mins before breakfast and do intervals/sprints. This is about total body conditioning. At the end, you'll feel stronger, more agile, more athletic, more toned. I don't know if you'll necessarily be "thinner" - that's a product of your ability to keep up the intensity of the workouts, which are pretty high-impact, and follow it with a good diet. But you'll definitely be in better shape.

A few things you should know about:

1. They're not kidding when they say it's intense and that you need a doctor's permission. These are gut-wrenching, nearly vomit-inducing workouts. If you push yourself to the max, which is what you should be doing, you'll feel like vomiting once in a while. If you're not in decent shape then you might have a very hard time with this. I'd recommend doing some jogging for a month prior if you haven't worked out in a while. IF YOU HAVE KNEE OR BACK PROBLEMS - BE CAREFUL. You do a lot of jumping and twisting here. I have good knees and felt a little tension there a couple times.

2. The workouts are repetitive, which is why I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars. There are basically like a half-dozen basic exercises, and each workout is essentially a remix of these. In the plyo workout you may do a little more jumping; in the cardio one you do a little less. But all in all, after 2 weeks I realized all the repetition and I had to fight boredom before my workouts and during. So listen, you'll need some will power and discipline. Yes, you'll think "it's the same workout all over again," but just hit Play and do it anyway.

3. The workouts get longer and you need to plan around this. The workouts during the first month are about 40 mins, which include almost 10 mins of stretching at beginning and end. (Even so, the remaining 30 mins are tough.) However, they get to be over an hour in the 2nd month, making this a very demanding program. You really need to plan your life around your workouts. I couldn't do these in the morning. I tried doing these after waking up, but I didn't have the energy, so I had to plan time in the evenings. I'm a horrible morning person, so maybe your mileage will vary.

4. You should couple these workouts with a proper diet. You don't need to skimp on the calories (you need energy to finish the workouts), but you should eat clean foods for all 60 days. What's the point of planning your life around these tough workouts, only to lose the maximum impact by not eating well? Do yourself a favor and eat right. This is a PROGRAM, not just a set of workouts.

Good luck!

I first want to say that I do not understand all the poor reviews that state Insanity is just too difficult, I didn't lose the 20,30,40 pounds, it's not for people with bad joints, causes injury (and now I'm ruined for life), etc. I don't want to minimize their complaints - especially if they got hurt - but it is called INSANITY for the love of God! Was that not clear at all in the infomercial? Were the repeated warnings of 'this is not for everyone' unclear? Were the disclaimers of 'results may vary' not clear? When doing the workout, do Shaun's constant reminders to 'rest and get back at it', listen to your body, etc. not register? And for those with joint problems - why on earth did you ever think an extreme program with jumping exercise would be for you? Bottom line - lack of common sense does not make this a bad product.
I am a stay-at-home mom of two kids and I am anything but athletic. I am no couch potato - but I haven't seen the inside of a gym for about 8 years. I get my exercise keeping up with my kids and cleaning my house/yard - period! Unfortunately, after having my last child and turning 40, that wasn't cutting it anymore. I was/am about 30 lbs overweight starting this program and I have been at it for 22 days now. Let me restate - I am NOT athletic and I am NOT in shape! In the beginning, I could do only 3 reps of a few of the exercises! It was sad! The point is, I listened to my body and rested when I needed to but didn't quit. Anything involving the 'Plank' position was next to impossible due to my weak little arms and the fact that I have had C-sections with each child, so my abs and core were weak. So I modified those a bit, and over just this short amount of time I am proud to say that I am doing all the exercises correctly and am up to at least 15 reps of even the toughest exercises, I have lost 4 pounds and am nearly down one pant size. I really feel as if I am on way to losing the 30 lbs and maybe more. But I don't expect it all in the first 60 days because my starting point was so weak.
Bottom line - this is an excellent fitness program for just about anyone who doesn't have health problems, uses good old common sense, takes it at their own pace (don't 'dig deeper' until you feel you can), and doesn't expect to grace any fitness mag covers after 60 days. Shaun T is wonderful, very motivational and easy to follow. I am really looking forward to seeing my results after the next 38 days. And I thoroughly expect to continue to use Insanity in the intervals suggested.

summary: Hardest Cardio Workout on DVD EVER!!
text: I am a self-professed queen of workout DVDs. I own them all: The Firm, Jillian Michaels, Moms Into Fitness Post-Natal series, Leslie Sansone, Hip Hop Abs, Piloxing, Kettlebells - you name it, I've had it in my workout repertoire. I'm always looking for something new to keep me motivated. The only time I have to workout is in the 5 AM hour before my toddler wakes up - so I want my workouts to be as efficient and effective as possible. Insanity is definitely the hardest cardio workout on DVD that I've ever experienced and I love the fact you don't need any equipment (you use your own body weight for upper body exercises). In 45 minutes I torch an average of 400 calories - my body definitely feels it and my energy levels have definitely gone up since I starting using the system. I cannot recommend it highly enough. I'm currently finishing up Month 1, I will post more when I get into Month 2. Some folks are concerned with the potential impact on knees, hips, wrists, and ankles - some of the exercises are definitely high impact, but I've found that by doing the 2 stretching sessions / yoga exercises that are built into the workout(after the cardio warm up and again at the end of the workout) - I haven't had any problems. A great buy!

I love this product.  I'm an a 26 year old active duty soldier, currently serving in Iraq.  I have been using this workout for several months and have noted huge increases in flexibility, strength, and endurance.  Shaun T's high intensity workouts are great for anyone who wants to strengthen and tone while increasing their cardio endurance.  I love the fast pace of the Shaun's interval training technique, it keeps me challenged and motivated.  I have tried some other fitness products like  P90X.  I found the P90X to contain effective exercises, but overall the workouts were long, tedious, and boring compared to working out with Shaun T.  After using Insanity for ten weeks, I was so impressed that I ordered the deluxe upgrade kit to get three additional workouts(insane abs, sports training and weight training).  Also I like to incorporate small weights and medicine balls into some of the exercises to increase resistance.  My only warning would be that there are several exercises in this program which may be considered high impact.  Just make sure you follow Shaun's instructions for proper form and wear comfortable cross-training shoes. If you want to challenge yourself physically and are serious about getting in shape, this may be the workout for you.  There really  isn't any beginner video in this set, so be ready to hit it starting day one.  The first couple weeks may be tough for you depending on your current fitness level, but after that you won't be able to get enough of this workout.  This program is worth three times what it costs.  I would highly recommend it to anyone wanting to maximize their fitness.
